summary: Read-only audit of the Gizmo app's UI layer: styles, theme tokens, and component implementations across features/conversation, sessions, and settings. Confirmed a real bug where `--space-7` is referenced in workspace-dashboard.css but never defined, causing that margin-top to collapse to 0; confirmed three files violate the 11px font-size floor by using 10px; and computed WCAG contrast ratios for the Solarized palette showing accent-on-accent-soft (3.43) and faint-on-surface (3.76) fail AA for normal text.
errors: --space-7 is consumed by workspace-dashboard.css line 189 but never defined as a token, so the margin-top declaration is invalid at computed-value time and resolves to 0, collapsing the section heading against the facts block.

10px font-sizes appear in composer-parts/editor.css:109, dialogs-parts/command-palette.css:83, and dialogs-parts/workspace-picker.css:232, violating the stated 11px minimum from DESIGN.md / tokens-base.

WCAG contrast: accent #d54f35 on accent-soft #f8e4de is 3.43:1 and text-faint #7d8375 on surface #fafbf7 is 3.76:1, both below the 4.5:1 AA threshold for normal text; accent-on-white at 4.20:1 also fails AA.
